They need Gina's sign-off (register C21). Round 4 copy (owner's approval, 1 November 2026): docs/copy-review/COPY-DECK.md. Gina's lines that match wexas.com word for word were replaced with new wording that keeps her facts; her unmatched lines are unchanged. Open questions for her are listed at the end of the deck. They were "Luxury travel with / Travelling Places." and "Luxury, planned with you.", which repeated the brand name and said luxury twice.

intro.heading: What luxury means to us
paragraphs: A fine hotel is only part of a luxury trip. The rest is the advisor behind it and the extras that come through Virtuoso. Here is how we look after each part.
